# Subway Seat for Telegram

Sets all 586 keys of the Telegram Desktop palette, with a plain walnut chat background bundled in. Outgoing bubbles take a soft orange tint; media viewer and calls stay dark in every flavor.

[Telegram](https://desktop.telegram.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/telegram/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Telegram Desktop → Settings → Chat Settings → Choose from file:

```text
subway-seat.tdesktop-theme
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Telegram Desktop → Settings → Chat Settings → Choose from file:

```text
subway-seat-tunnel.tdesktop-theme
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Telegram Desktop → Settings → Chat Settings → Choose from file:

```text
subway-seat-enamel.tdesktop-theme
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `open subway-seat.tdesktop-theme in Telegram Desktop`.
- Delete `inside subway-seat.tdesktop-theme`.
- Delete `open subway-seat-tunnel.tdesktop-theme in Telegram Desktop`.
- Delete `inside subway-seat-tunnel.tdesktop-theme`.
- Delete `open subway-seat-enamel.tdesktop-theme in Telegram Desktop`.
- Delete `inside subway-seat-enamel.tdesktop-theme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
